invariants.description: v is exactly the 8-harmonic Fourier series Σ A_i cos(2π i t/T + φ_i) (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(v - (A_0*np.cos(2*np.pi*0*t/T + phi_0) + A_1*np.cos(2*np.pi*1*t/T + phi_1) + A_2*np.cos(2*np.pi*2*t/T + phi_2) + A_3*np.cos(2*np.pi*3*t/T + phi_3) + A_4*np.cos(2*np.pi*4*t/T + phi_4) + A_5*np.cos(2*np.pi*5*t/T + phi_5) + A_6*np.cos(2*np.pi*6*t/T + phi_6) + A_7*np.cos(2*np.pi*7*t/T + phi_7) + A_8*np.cos(2*np.pi*8*t/T + phi_8)))) <= 1e-9*max(1e-30, np.max(np.abs(v)))

invariants.description: v is periodic with the heart period T: its mean over the last whole period equals A_0 cos φ_0 (1e-3 of max |v|)
invariants.expr: abs(np.trapz(v[t >= t[-1] - T], t[t >= t[-1] - T])/T - A_0*np.cos(phi_0)) <= 1e-3*np.max(np.abs(v)) + 1e-12

invariants.description: vessel volume balance: q(t) − q(0) = ∫(v − v_vessel) dt (trapezoidal, 0.1%)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((va__q - va__q[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(((v) - (va__v))[1:] + ((v) - (va__v))[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-3*max(1e-12, np.max(np.abs(va__q - va__q[0])))

bc_sweep.rationale: Amplitudes are swept by factors 0.5-2 of their nominal values (zero harmonics mostly left at zero, A_2 swept to 2e-4 as a representative), phases over the full circle for a zero and a non-zero harmonic, and T from 0.5 to 2 s (heart rates 30-120 bpm). P is excluded: it is the pressure the connected vessel supplies.

baseline.reason: candidate: fit the 8 harmonics to a published measured aortic-root inflow waveform (e.g. the openly available input data of the Boileau et al. 2015 1D benchmark) and compare v(t) with it; not set up because no source with explicit Fourier coefficients was verified.

calibrate.note: pending: same candidate: calibrate A_i, phi_i to the measured inflow waveform and validate on a held-out cycle.
